frame.converter: Astropy SkyCoord Galactic to ICRS, heliocentric Cartesian

meaning: 6.7 GHz methanol masers compiled by Hou & Han (2014), which mark massive star formation in the arms: each at its photometric or trigonometric distance where published, otherwise at the authors' kinematic distance for R0 = 8.3 kpc (D8.3).

appearance.note: Presentation only: a pale rose between the maser white and the HII pink.
appearance.emphasis: Arm tracer: young, massive star formation that outlines the spiral arms, drawn at full strength.

missingBasis: Two masers (l = 106.797° and 109.920°) have no measured distance and a kinematic D8.3 of 0.00 kpc, which would put them at the Sun; they count as without a distance.

mapWeight.basis: Hou & Han (2014), Sect. 2.4 and Eq. 2: a weight for the kind of tracer, times 0.5/σ in each disc axis (1 when σ < 0.5 kpc) for a kinematic distance, with σ from a ±7 km/s velocity uncertainty through a flat rotation curve (R0 = 8.3 kpc, Θ0 = 239 km/s, their adopted set). W_m = 0.1.
